text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* Italy's bicameral commission aimed at carrying out constitutional reforms started approving draft laws about justice, federalism and Europe but delayed to Wednesday the debate about whether to favour a stronger premiership or a stronger leadership of the president. The separatist Northern League so far refused to join the talks but is now apparently willing to take part, even though its stand remained unclear (all).

* Enron Corp confirmed its Enron Europe Ltd unit would form an electricity generating joint venture with Italian utility ENEL. The 50/50 joint venture will own up to 5,000 megawatts of power plants currently owned by Enel and will supply customers in Europe (all).
* Banking group San Paolo di Brescia confirmed its interest in purchasing fellow banking group Credito Bergamasco, controlled by French banking group Credit Lyonnais (Sole 24 Ore).
** Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
